title: Full-support normalization of the canonical exterior product
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f:X→S, g:Y→S, and isomorphisms i:Z→X and j:W→Y of schemes. Let K,L be arbitrary unbounded etale A-module complexes on X,Y. If the canonical ordinary absolute product [def-pur-ordinary-kunneth-absolute-map] for the two product projections and K,L is invertible, then the actual supported product [def-pur-supported-exterior-product] for i,j,K,L is invertible. Neither finiteness, a field base nor a boundedness or Tor-amplitude condition is required.

source.place: Paragraph 1, full-support specialization of the exterior product definition; literature/stacks-project/etale-cohomology.tex, remark-define-kunneth-map

proof.text: For an isomorphism i the underlying range is all of X, so i and the identity have equal open complements. Their support-kernel inclusions are therefore the same after this equality. The identity-support right-derived inclusion is invertible by fullSupportForget_isIso in [lem-pur-support-site-comparison], so the derived inclusion for i is invertible. Apply the same argument to j and to the product immersion, which is an isomorphism because pullback.map preserves isomorphisms.

The equality [lem-pur-supported-product-forget-supports] identifies the actual supported product followed by the target forgetful map with the tensor of the two source forgetful maps followed by the ordinary product. The right side is a composite of isomorphisms under the hypothesis. Cancel the target forgetful isomorphism. No boundedness or geometric finiteness assumption was used.

theorem isIso_supportedExteriorProduct_of_fullSupport
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {S X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S) (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : W ⟶ Y)
    [IsIso i] [IsIso j]
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y)
    (h : IsIso (ordinaryGlobalKunnethMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
      (pullback.fst f g) (pullback.snd f g) K L)) :
    IsIso (supportedExteriorProduct A f g i j K L)
